manual.other_engineers.line2: Outside of the comfortable compound of any engineer are others less fortified.{0}
manual.other_engineers.line3: Inside of the villages and towns of the world come a variety of inhabitants who farm and build. Among these come some engineers at the forefront of the field in their towns, pushing against the tide.{0}
manual.other_engineers.line4: Common trades among those that ply designs and devices in the markets of the world are below.{0}
manual.other_engineers.line5: {0} The §lStructural Engineer§r deals in common construction materials such as treated wood, scaffolding, and concrete.{1}
manual.other_engineers.line6: Once they're experienced enough to prospect, they may even sell you a treasure map to a nearby {0}Mineral Vein{1}...{2}
manual.other_engineers.line7: The workstation of the Structural Engineer is a §2Turntable§r.{0}
manual.other_engineers.line8: {0}The §lMachinist§r is an expert in metals, mechanics and tools.{1}
manual.other_engineers.line9: They trade in various components and engineering blocks needed for assembling multiblock machinery. Master machinists may even sell heads for powered tools.{0}
manual.other_engineers.line10: The workstation of the Machinist is an §2Engineer's Crafting Table§r.{0}
manual.other_engineers.line11: {0} The §lElectrician§r deals in wires and basic electronics components.{1}
manual.other_engineers.line12: As they get more experienced, their fascination turns to higher voltages, offering pieces of a faraday suit and tesla coils!{0}
manual.other_engineers.line13: The workstation of the Electrician is an §2Engineer's Circuit Table§r.{0}
manual.other_engineers.line14: {0}The §lGunsmith§r deals with the recently popular firearms, including blueprints.{1}
manual.other_engineers.line15: Apart from buying gunpowder and offering their skills in ammunition loading, they also manufacture unique component pieces for the {0}Revolver{1}.{2}
manual.other_engineers.line16: The workstation of the Gunsmith is an §2Engineer's Workbench§r.{0}
manual.other_engineers.line17: {0} The §lOutfitter§r may not seem like a traditional engineer, although their field of work is no less precise!{1}
manual.other_engineers.line18: Whereas others manufacture components, they instead design unique colour patterns known as {0}Shaders{1}.{2}
manual.other_engineers.line19: While purchasing elegant materials such as tough fabric, silver and gold, they sell shader grab bags, enabling you to randomly acquire pieces of their craft.{0}
manual.other_engineers.line20: The workstation of the Outfitter is a §2Shader Banner§r, which is created by using a shader on a normal, placed banner.
